title: 6/8 Strumming Pattern with Missing Beats (1, 2 and 3, 4, 5 and 6) – JustinGuitar
summary: In this JustinGuitar lesson, the instructor introduces a concrete 6/8 strumming pattern by first establishing the feel of 6/8 with a down-strum on every beat and an accent on beats 1 and 4. He then demonstrates a distinctive variation that omits beats 2 and 5, resulting in the counting 1, 2 and 3, 4, 5 and 6 (and the alternates shown for 1, 2 and 3, 4, 5 and 6). The hand continues moving even when a beat is skipped, and the pattern is rendered as Down, Up, Down, Down, Up, Down, with an optional extra upstroke after beat 6 to extend the groove. The video emphasizes slow, deliberate practice, maintaining continuous motion, and gradually increasing tempo, with encouragement to apply the pattern to 6/8 songs and to experiment freely within the rhythm framework.
